have zip_fst_eq :
      ∀ (as : List P.Ident) (bs : List P.Expr),
        as.length = bs.length →
        (as.zip bs).unzip.1 = as := by
    intro as
    induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs Hlen
      cases bs with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b bs => simp at Hlen
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs Hlen
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at Hlen
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at Hlen
        simp [ih bs Hlen]

have zip_fst_eq :
      ∀ (as : List P.Ident) (bs : List P.Expr),
        as.length = bs.length →
        (as.zip bs).unzip.1 = as := by
    intro as
    induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs Hlen
      cases bs with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b bs => simp at Hlen
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs Hlen
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at Hlen
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at Hlen
        simp [ih bs Hlen]
